description: The user wrote in the open day: its whole text. A new id starts today's entry. left is true when the user has just left the writing box.

left.description: True when the writing box was left, so every paragraph of the day is finished, the last one too. A later save without it, while typing, makes the last paragraph unfinished again.

finished.description: The texts of the lines the user finished with this save (moved off the line, Enter, the box losing focus, a paste), so a hashtag check asks only finished lines. Absent when none.
